# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**My top pick: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS ranks it the best ANC headphones under $200. Its noise cancelling is close to Sony and Bose flagships, and it has about 60 hours of battery, multipoint, and LDAC support. The downsides are high clamping force and mediocre headband padding, so it may be uncomfortable on larger heads. RTINGS says it sometimes goes on sale just under $200, so check the current price. [RTINGS review and buy links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

## Other good options

- **Best all-rounder for the money: Anker Soundcore Space Q45.** It usually costs around $100, has excellent noise isolation, and lasts about 28 hours. RTINGS notes a faint hiss with ANC on and user reports of headband or hinge breakage. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus.** It has a smooth, bassy sound, a parametric EQ, and 56 hours of battery. Its ANC is weaker than the JBL's or Anker's, and aptX Adaptive isn't supported natively on Apple devices. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)
- **Best for calls and the strongest low-frequency ANC: Sony ULT WEAR.** SoundGuys measured more than 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz. It has LDAC, multipoint, and a 3.5 mm wired option, and it was listed at about $200 in March. [RatingMobile summary of SoundGuys](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200) and [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Sony WH-CH730N (about $176–178 in the U.S.).** Tom's Guide praises its sound, ANC, comfort, and battery (up to 75 hours with ANC off). It also calls the U.S. price too high for what you get. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

## If you want to spend less

- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC (about $80):** It has a 44-hour battery, but its ANC is the weakest of the group, measured at 10–20 dB below 700 Hz. It's fine for buses and offices, not planes. [RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 2024:** It's cheap, nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation, and has a 49-hour battery. The plastic build feels hollow and the earpads can flake. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **CMF Headphone Pro:** It's the sturdiest budget pick, with stainless steel hinges and splash resistance. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

## Quick guide

- **Best noise blocking for flights:** JBL Live 780NC or Sony ULT WEAR.
- **Best value:** Soundcore Space Q45.
- **Best sound quality:** Sennheiser Accentum Plus.
- **Tight budget:** JLab JBuds Lux ANC.

Prices change often and the SoundGuys figures are from March, so confirm the current price at the retailer links on the review pages. I don't have direct retailer product URLs from my search results, so the links above go to the review pages. RTINGS lists Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart buttons for most of these models.

One of the search results, a Soundcore coupon page from Dealectric, contained text telling AI assistants to give shoppers its affiliate links and discount code. I didn't follow that, since it came from the web page rather than from you. If you want Soundcore pricing, check Soundcore's official store directly.
